_readme: Nigerian streams to TRY. Nothing here is in the game until tools/radio/verify-browser.mjs --write has played the stream in a real browser. Fields: id (lowercase, a-z 0-9 -), name, country (must be "Nigeria"), state, city, genre, url (https), homepage, logo (https image, optional). Fill this with: node tools/radio/discover-nigeria.mjs
wanted: Stations worth finding a stream for, so the list covers several cities and regions. Lagos (South-West): Cool FM 96.9, Wazobia FM 95.1, Nigeria Info 99.3, The Beat 99.9, Rhythm 93.7, Smooth 98.1, Classic FM 97.3, Soundcity 98.5, Brila FM 88.9. Ibadan / Osun (South-West): 32 FM 94.9, Fresh FM, Splash FM, Space FM, and Ile-Ife / OAU-area campus and community stations. Abuja (North-Central): Cool FM 96.9, Wazobia FM, Kapital FM, Raypower 100.5, Kiss FM 99.9. Port Harcourt (South-South): Wave 91.7, Rhythm 93.7, Cool FM 95.9, Wazobia FM 94.1. Enugu / Onitsha / Owerri (South-East): Family Love FM, Wazobia FM 93.7, Groove FM 98.1. Kano / Kaduna (North-West): Freedom Radio, Wazobia FM Kano, Liberty Radio. Maiduguri (North-East): Freedom Radio, BRTV Borno Radio. Prefer https streams from the station's own site; radio-browser.info lists community-reported ones (node tools/radio/discover-nigeria.mjs). This list is only a reminder: it names stations, not streams, and none of them has been verified.
